items.title: Kubernetes v1.37: Native Histograms Graduates to Beta

sentences.en: Kubernetes v1.37: Native Histograms Graduates to Beta.
sentences.zh: Kubernetes v 1.37 ：原生直方图毕业生测试版。

sentences.en: I'm excited to announce that native histogram support for Kubernetes metrics is graduating to Beta and is enabled by default in Kubernetes v1.37!
sentences.zh: 我很高兴地宣布， Kubernetes指标的原生直方图支持将升级到Beta版，并在Kubernetes v 1.37中默认启用！

sentences.en: Native histograms (previously introduced as Alpha in Kubernetes v1.36 under KEP-5808 ) bring high-resolution, low-cardinality observability to Kubernetes metrics.
sentences.zh: 原生直方图（之前在KEP-5808下的Kubernetes v 1.36中作为Alpha引入）为Kubernetes指标带来了高分辨率、低卡迪纳斯可观察性。

sentences.en: By adopting Prometheus Native Histograms , Kubernetes components now expose latency and duration metrics with far greater accuracy while significantly reducing telemetry storage and scraping overhead.
sentences.zh: 通过采用Prometheus原生直方图， Kubernetes组件现在以更高的准确性暴露延迟和持续时间指标，同时显着减少遥测存储和抓取开销。

sentences.en: Why move beyond classic histograms?
sentences.zh: 为什么要超越经典直方图？

sentences.en: Since the early days of Kubernetes observability, duration and latency metrics (such as API server request latencies or scheduling durations) have relied on classic Prometheus histograms .
sentences.zh: 自Kubernetes可观测性的早期以来，持续时间和延迟指标（例如API服务器请求延迟或调度持续时间）一直依赖于经典的Prometheus直方图。

sentences.en: Classic histograms require metric authors to define a static list of cumulative bucket boundaries ( le labels), such as 0.005, 0.01, 0.025, 0.05, 0.1, 0.25, 0.5, 1, 2.5, 5, 10 .

While familiar, this approach introduces three major challenges: The Bucket Guessing Game : If a workload's latency profile changes, for example, shifting into microsecond ranges or experiencing long-tail tail latencies beyond the highest bucket, the histogram loses visibility.
sentences.zh: 虽然熟悉，但这种方法引入了三大挑战：桶猜测游戏：如果工作负载的延迟配置文件发生变化，例如，切换到微秒范围或经历超出最高桶的长尾延迟，则直方图将失去可见性。

sentences.en: Specifying bucket boundaries upfront requires knowing the distribution before observing it High Cardinality & Storage Cost : With classic histograms, each bucket boundary is exported as a separate time series ( _bucket{le=".."
sentences.zh: 预先指定桶边界需要在观察分布之前了解分布高基数和存储成本：使用经典直方图，每个桶边界都导出为单独的时间序列(_bucket {le = ".."

sentences.en: A histogram with 10 buckets across multiple labels multiplies the number of time series by 10, increasing memory consumption in Prometheus and inflating time series database (TSDB) storage costs Interpolation Error in Quantiles : Calculating percentiles using histogram_quantile() relies on linear interpolation between static bucket boundaries.
sentences.zh: 在多个标签上具有10个桶的直方图将时间序列的数量乘以10 ，增加了Prometheus中的内存消耗和膨胀时间序列数据库（ TSDB ）存储成本分数中的插值误差：使用histogram_quantile （ ）计算百分位数依赖于静态桶边界之间的线性插值。

sentences.en: When bucket spans are coarse, quantile calculations can suffer from significant estimation error What are Prometheus native histograms?
sentences.zh: 当桶跨度粗略时，分位数计算可能会出现显著的估计误差普罗米修斯原生直方图是什么？

items.title: Marketing ops as code: Automating events from planning to follow-up on GitHub

sentences.en: Marketing ops as code: Automating events from planning to follow-up on GitHub.
sentences.zh: 营销运营作为代码：在GitHub上实现从规划到跟进事件的自动化。

sentences.en: I run marketing for GitHub in Japan and Korea, and events are the heartbeat of it: a recurring webinar series for enterprise developers, community meetups in Tokyo, invite-only executive sessions in Seoul.
sentences.zh: 我在日本和韩国为GitHub开展营销活动，活动就是其中的心跳：针对企业开发人员的定期网络研讨会系列、东京的社区见面会、首尔的仅限受邀参加的高管会议。

sentences.en: What does a developer in this market actually need right now?
sentences.zh: 这个市场的开发人员现在实际需要什么？

sentences.en: Which topics are worth an hour of their time, and who should be in the room?
sentences.zh: 哪些主题值得花费一小时的时间，哪些人应该在房间里？

sentences.en: I d happily spend all day on those questions.
sentences.zh: 我很乐意花一整天的时间在这些问题上。

sentences.en: What follows the decisions is another matter.
sentences.zh: 接下来的决定是另一回事。

sentences.en: Once an event is greenlit, a fixed sequence begins: Duplicate a landing page on our event platform.
sentences.zh: 活动被绿灯照亮后，一个固定的顺序开始：在我们的活动平台上复制登录页面。

sentences.en: Generate a set of UTM-tagged links: one for each channel, each formatted just so.
sentences.zh: 生成一组带UTM标记的链接：每个频道一个，每个格式都是这样。

sentences.en: Draft the invitation email and file a request with the team that sends it.
sentences.zh: 起草邀请电子邮件，并向发送该电子邮件的团队提交请求。

sentences.en: Add the event to two project boards.
sentences.zh: 将事件添加到两个项目板。

sentences.en: Every morning until the event: download the registrant list, clean it up, post a status update for stakeholders.
sentences.zh: 每天早上直至活动结束：下载注册人名单，将其清理干净，为利益相关者发布状态更新。

sentences.en: After the event: export the attendees, reshape the list for a CRM upload, tag the right records, and write a report.
sentences.zh: 活动结束后：导出与会者，重塑CRM上传列表，标记正确的记录，并撰写报告。

items.title: ‘Absurd, hardline calls’: questions over Sweden’s post-Brexit migration policy

sentences.en: ‘Absurd, hardline calls’: questions over Sweden’s post-Brexit migration policy.
sentences.zh: “荒谬，强硬的电话” ：对瑞典脱欧后移民政策的质疑。

sentences.en: Sweden has ordered more Britons, including vulnerable people, to leave post-Brexit than any other EU country He arrived with nothing other than the clothes he wore that morning.
sentences.zh: 瑞典命令更多的英国人，包括弱势群体，在英国脱欧后离开，比任何其他欧盟国家都要多。他抵达时除了那天早上穿的衣服外，一无所有。

sentences.en: Hours later he was banged up in a detention centre close to a Stockholm airport to await deportation.
sentences.zh: 几个小时后，他在斯德哥尔摩机场附近的一个拘留中心被殴打，等待被驱逐出境。

sentences.en: Charles, a former business director from Cambridge, who did not want his full name published, moved to Sweden in 2017 to be with his Swedish wife, Lily, and applied to remain after Brexit, before the deadline of December 2021.
sentences.zh: 来自剑桥的前业务总监查尔斯（ Charles ）不希望自己的全名被公开，于2017年搬到瑞典，与瑞典妻子莉莉（ Lily ）在一起，并在2021年12月的最后期限之前申请在英国退欧后留下。

sentences.zh: 继续阅读
